cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/target_compare.py <<'PY'
import sys,json,subprocess,random
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from refcollector import run_case
cases=[]
rnd=random.Random(99)
for prim in ['allreduce','reduce','broadcast','barrier','allgather','reducescatter']:
 for mode in [2,3]:
  K=1 if prim=='barrier' else (24 if prim!='reducescatter' else 20)
  D=0 if prim=='barrier' else 3
  N=rnd.choice([3,5,8])
  ranks=[0,1,2,3];rnd.shuffle(ranks)
  ev=[{'op':'train','p':0,'count':K,'width':min(N,4),'ranks':ranks,'reverse':rnd.choice([True,False]),'seed':rnd.randrange(1<<32)}]
  # issue cumulative output ACKs huge enough for output spaces
  for rep in range(2):
   for r in range(4):
    upto=3*K if prim=='allgather' else (K//4 if prim=='reducescatter' else 1 if prim=='barrier' else K)
    ev.append({'op':'ack','rank':r,'upto':upto})
  if mode==2:
   ev.append({'op':'flush'})
  ev.append({'op':'retry','rank':rnd.randrange(4)})
  ev.append({'op':'budget','n':rnd.choice([0,1,2,10])})
  ev.append({'op':'flush'})
  ev.append({'op':'budget','n':-1})
  ev.append({'op':'flush'})
  ev.append({'op':'snap','tag':prim+str(mode)})
  c={'primitive':prim,'mode':mode,'root':rnd.randrange(4),'segments':K,'words':D,'capacity':N,'start':rnd.choice([0,0xffffff,0xffff00]),'events':ev,'trace':32}
  cases.append(c)
req={'cases':cases}
p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'project/solver.py'],input=json.dumps(req).encode(),stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
print('ret',p.returncode,p.stderr.decode()[:500])
out=json.loads(p.stdout)['cases']
for i,c in enumerate(cases):
 exp=run_case(c)
 if out[i]!=exp:
  print('MISMATCH',i,c['primitive'],c['mode'])
  for k in exp:
   if out[i][k]!=exp[k]:
    print(k);print('C',out[i][k]);print('R',exp[k])
  break
else:print('ALL TARGET OK')
PY
